motion_rule: he shoulders down the alley all clip while slips, snow and the worker burst on his coat at the lens every beat; the camera tracks alongside, lockers sweeping past, his face to the lens, his head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a shaggy musk ox, heavy fringed coat, broad horns, muzzle clear of his hooves
second_characters: ONE worker in an orange hi-vis vest and hard hat with a wide shovel, big in frame a shoulder from the lens, up on the crates then striding alongside
props: ONE plastic card frozen into his chest fur from the first beat; A SWARM of paper slips building a drift on his back
environment: a parcel alley at noon, lockers and postbox towers to the roof both sides a hoof away, crates and banked snow along their tops, no far wall
light_events: sun between the lockers whips bars across his face every beat

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: deep chesty male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 3.6 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: pod-PEE-sok, sug-ROP, da-YUT, pla-CHU — stress CHU, he pays, never PLA-chu meaning weeping
audio.pacing: 0.45-3.45, 4.25-5.65 and 6.45-7.55 each one breath; after 7.55 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw drops wide and his lips shape every syllable, brows and jaw alive, muzzle clear of hooves and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: alley wind, locker doors, paper slapping fur, a shovel scraping and snow thumping on his horns at 3.45, the drift at 8.25

timeline.a: he shoulders into the alley, the drift on his back, the card in his chest fur
he drives his chest through a wall of slips flying at the lens, they plaster his shoulders, muzzle clear
he swings his horns and takes a locker door open across them, never breaking stride
he hauls his shoulder along the locker row and rakes a sheaf of slips onto his coat
he throws his head back at the lens and the drift heaps up another hand higher
the worker on the crates a shoulder away hurls a full shovel of snow onto his crown, it bursts white over his horns into the lens, muzzle clear, and he ploughs on without a check
he ploughs on and shrugs one flank clean, snow and slips peeling off past the lens
he bodies a locker bank open with his shoulder as he ploughs down the row
he digs his muzzle into his fur after the card and comes up with slips on his horns
he drives his chest at the lens, the card showing through the fur
he rips the card out of his chest and waves it past the lens beside his muzzle, ploughing on
the worker drops off the crates alongside and slings a second shovel across the lens, snow bursting on his flank as he shoulders past
he shakes out and the whole drift and snow lift off him into the lens
he drives on through the falling paper, his coat under it thin and bare to the ribs
he flicks the card off his hoof into the lens, face to it, and shoulders on

must_appear: one card in his fur; at 3.45 a worker in an orange vest and hard hat drops a shovel of real snow on his head off the crates; at 8.25 the drift lifts off, his coat under it thin and bare; at 9.50 he flicks the card into the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a held pose, a closed muzzle while speaking, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
